bucket_reason: Confidence is still med after the funded corner_rules stage. Almost all corner events are now ruled and validated, but three small sub-families and one invariant clause are still open, so H* does not yet close without exceptions.
question: Fund one more short stage to rule #16's last three corner sub-families and fix the H* clause for the RightEndP1 output, before proof.md?

options.label: One more corner stage
options.consequence: About 1.5-2 h, 1-2 light processes, no Coq. (1) Extend the macro grammar with the segment-less bouncer 0^inf <A (10)^a0 (010)^d and rule the P = 1 right end, including RightEndP from P = 3. (2) Rule Push1/Absorb at a wall with p = 0. (3) Rule V1 with d = 1 for odd q and nonempty Z. (4) Give the RightEndP1 hub (a0 = 5) its own collapse clause in H*c. Validate each by exact simulation and rerun the 2 x 10^4-orbit closure test. Target: 10,000/10,000 at levels <= 5,459. Exits: closed -> proof.md; a sub-family that leaves the grammar for good -> park.

options.label: Write proof.md now
options.consequence: Start the hub-to-hub induction (lemmas G, C, S on top of the macro rules; Conv/Transfer from TM5's P/P_S/P_S'). List the three open sub-families and the RightEndP1 clause as open lemmas. The proof stays incomplete until they are ruled.

options.label: Park
options.consequence: Status becomes parked at corner_rules. macro_sim2, the corner rules and the closure tests stay in scripts/ and notes.md.

rationale: 15 corner rule families validated exactly; 9,977/10,000 orbits ruled without margin at small levels.
Each open piece has one small parameter (P = 1, p = 0, d = 1); the probes show linear outcomes, no halts.
Ruling them first gives proof.md a closed invariant instead of open lemmas.

evidence.text: Corner rules by exact simulation: 10 families 40/40 and 5 families 30/30; negative controls 0/150.
Levels <= 5,459, no margin, 40 traversals: 9,977/10,000 orbits ruled; open: P = 1 right end 14, p = 0 wall 9; 0 halts.
Levels <= 1e30: 9,998/10,000 ruled; from blank, macro_sim2 = macro_sim on 4,000 right ends, all in H*c.
67 orbits leave H*c only at the RightEndP1 hub (a0 = 5, B(2) = 2 tau + 1) and stay ruled for 40 traversals.

effort_if_yes: One stage: about 1.5-2 h of agent time and 1-2 light processes (macro_sim2, exact simulation, hybrid closure test). No Coq.
